description: This Java class 'SecuredUpload' contains methods for validating uploaded files to ensure they are safe and secure. It includes checks for file extensions, content validation against web shells, malware, and malicious embedded content, and supports various file types such as images, PDFs, SVGs, archives, audio, and video files. The class also handles complex validation like inspecting PDFs for embedded scripts or JavaScript, and verifying that images do not contain embedded webshell payloads.

classes.name: SecuredUpload
classes.description: Main class providing methods for secure file validation during uploads, including validation of file extensions, content malware checks, embedded content inspection, and format-specific safety checks.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Checks if the text content is free from webshells, reverse shells, or malicious payloads, with options for query parameter analysis.

methods.name: isValidFileName
methods.description: Validates filename against security rules, such as disallowing double extensions, special characters, and denied extensions.

methods.name: isValidAllFile
methods.description: Validates a file for security, considering all validation rules.

methods.name: isValidFile
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation based on file type, including images, PDFs, compressed files, etc.

methods.name: isValidImageFile
methods.description: Checks if an image is of a supported format and free from embedded malicious content.

methods.name: isValidImageIncludingSvgFile
methods.description: Validates both raster images and SVG files for safety.

methods.name: isValidSvgFile
methods.description: Validates SVG files, including parsing and content validation.

methods.name: isPdfFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a PDF by attempting to read it with PdfReader.

methods.name: isValidPdfFile
methods.description: Verifies PDF contents for embedded scripts or malicious features, ensuring it is safe.

methods.name: isValidCsvFile
methods.description: Validates CSV files for correct formatting and content security.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a file is a known executable type or script, rejecting it for security reasons.

methods.name: isValidCompressedFile
methods.description: Validates ZIP files and inspects contained files for safety.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromFileName
methods.description: Infers MIME type of file based on filename extension, used for validation and checking.

methods.name: isValidDirectoryInCompressedFile
methods.description: Recursively validates files inside unzipped directories for security compliance.

methods.name: recursiveParserWrapper
methods.description: Uses Apache Tika to parse archive files and extract embedded document types for validation.

methods.name: isValidAudioFile
methods.description: Verifies that audio files are of supported and safe formats.

methods.name: isValidVideoFile
methods.description: Verifies that video files are of supported and safe formats.

methods.name: isValidTextFile
methods.description: Validates text files for specific content issues or injections, including encoding validations.

methods.name: noWebshellInMetadata
methods.description: Inspects image metadata for embedded webshell payloads.

methods.name: noWebshellInPNG
methods.description: Checks PNG files for malicious IDAT chunks or embedded scripts.
